title: 瑠璃の交易路と、忘却の砂海の残響
author: 砂原 オアシス

prediction.question: 白銀の将軍ヴァレリウスが現れた市場で、次に何が起きる？
options: ヴァレリウスがザイドを捕縛する

en.title: The Azure Trade Route and Echoes of the Forgotten Sand Sea
en.premise: Though the light of the Holy Sword broke the chain of 'Sandification,' the lost memories of Elias and the void carved into the world remained. Zaid, a guide, and his companion Lydia venture into a strange 'Market of Memories' that thrives on the recollections of others. There, they encounter a mysterious group hoarding the memories of past heroes and uncover legends of the 'Oasis of Oblivion' slumbering in the desert's abyss. In a reborn world, a new pilgrimage begins—a journey to reclaim lost bonds and a forgotten history.

zh.title: 瑠璃之交易路与忘却砂海之残响
zh.premise: 虽圣剑之光斩断了“砂化”的连锁，但埃利亚斯失落的记忆以及刻在世界上的空白之洞依然未能填补。引导人扎伊德与莉迪亚一同踏入了以人们的记忆为食而繁荣的奇妙“记忆市场”。在那里，他们遇到了买断昔日英雄记忆的神秘组织，以及沉睡在沙漠深渊中的“忘却之绿洲”的传说。在重生后的世界中，一场围绕着失落羁绊与失落历史的新巡礼就此开启。
